content: .{@-चक्षुस्, -नयन@} {%a.%} blind; (<ab>lit.</ab> having understanding as the only eyes); ततो ज्ञास्यसि मां सौते प्रज्ञाचक्षुषमित्युत <ls>Mb. 1. 1. 149</ls>; <ls>Bhāg. 1. 13. 28</ls>; <ls>Manodūta 115</ls>; <ls>N. 12. 106</ls>. --({%m.%}) an epithet of Dhṛtarāṣṭra; <ls>Mb. 3. 7. 24</ls>; <ls>Kāvyamālā, Part. 13</ls>. --({%n.%}) the mindʼs eye, mental eye, the mind; <ls>M. 1</ls>.
